title: Uralic Sun and Moon
description: This resource pack replaces the sun and moon with the corresponding symbols of 2 peoples of the Uralic language family - Udmurts and Komi.
body: This resource pack replaces the sun and moon with the corresponding symbols of 2 peoples of the Uralic language family - Udmurts and Komi. The Udmurts have a moon - tolez' , and the Komi have a sun - shondi.
